title: A Crack Smaller Than a Coin Dropped a Whole Bridge

lines: One crack, smaller than a coin, dropped this entire bridge.
At rush hour it fell into the Ohio River, and forty six people died.
It collapsed in under a minute.
The crack hid inside one eyebar in the suspension chain.
Corrosion and stress slowly grew it deeper.
When that single link snapped, nothing else could hold the load.
The bridge had no backup path.
That's why American bridges now get mandatory inspections.
